name: implicit_bare_query_string
reason: response_type=token is the deprecated implicit grant flow; the access token returns in the URL fragment.

name: implicit_json_key_value
reason: JSON-style response_type key set to the literal value token.

name: implicit_camelcase_single_quote
reason: camelCase responseType set to 'token' is the same implicit-flow misconfiguration.

name: implicit_yaml_bare
reason: Unquoted YAML/config-style response_type: token is still the implicit grant.

name: implicit_spaced_equals_quoted
reason: Whitespace around = and a single-quoted token value is still the implicit flow.

name: wildcard_bare_star
reason: A bare * redirect_uri accepts any callback URL whatsoever.

name: wildcard_json_star
reason: JSON redirect_uri set to the literal wildcard string.

name: wildcard_scheme_subdomain
reason: A subdomain wildcard lets an attacker who takes over any acme-app.example.com subdomain receive the OAuth response (SKILL.md Scenario 1).

name: wildcard_plural_key_string_value
reason: The plural redirect_uris spelling with a subdomain-wildcard string value is the same misconfiguration.

name: wildcard_path_suffix_star
reason: A trailing wildcard path lets any path under the host receive the OAuth callback.

name: usercontrolled_query_dot_redirect
reason: redirect_uri is assigned directly from an Express query parameter chosen by the caller.

name: usercontrolled_flask_args_get
reason: Flask request.args.get("redirect_uri") pulls the redirect straight from the querystring.

name: usercontrolled_body_dot_redirect_uri
reason: redirect_uri is taken directly from the parsed request body.

name: usercontrolled_camel_params
reason: camelCase redirectUri assigned from req.params is still user-controlled input.

name: usercontrolled_django_get_style
reason: Django-style request.GET.get('redirect_uri') reads the redirect target from the querystring.

name: usercontrolled_direct_expression_in_redirect_call
reason: The OAuth callback redirects straight to a caller-supplied query parameter with no allowlist check (open redirect).

name: clean_code_flow_bare_with_pkce
reason: Authorization-code flow with PKCE and a URL-encoded exact redirect_uri; no token, wildcard, or request-sourced redirect.

name: clean_code_flow_json
reason: response_type=code is the recommended authorization-code flow, not the implicit flow.

name: clean_code_flow_camelcase
reason: camelCase responseType set to code is still the safe authorization-code flow.

name: clean_id_token_out_of_scope
reason: id_token is a distinct OIDC value from the bare implicit-flow token shape this rule targets; left clean to avoid over-broad matching.

name: clean_hybrid_flow_space_separated
reason: The hybrid flow value 'code token' does not match the bare response_type=token shape and is out of scope for this narrow rule.

name: clean_exact_redirect_literal
reason: An exact-match allowlisted literal redirect_uri with no wildcard and no request-derived value.

name: clean_redirect_from_env_var
reason: Sourced from a deployment environment variable, not from request input, and contains no wildcard.

name: clean_redirect_from_config_constant
reason: Sourced from a static config object, not from req/request, and contains no wildcard.

name: clean_redirect_uris_array_exact_match
reason: An allowlist array of exact-match literals with no wildcard glob in either entry.

name: clean_session_get_not_request_input
reason: session.get reads a previously validated, server-side stored value, not raw request input.

name: clean_unrelated_query_param
reason: The querystring key read here is 'next', unrelated to redirect_uri/redirect.

name: clean_function_call_not_request
reason: The value comes from a local helper function, not directly from request input, and has no wildcard.

name: clean_comment_mentioning_wildcard
input: // NOTE: wildcard (*) origins are blocked by the API gateway
reason: Prose mentioning wildcard has no response_type or redirect_uri key at all.

name: clean_pkce_code_verifier_line
reason: PKCE code_verifier generation is unrelated to any of the three flagged shapes.
